spatial_identity_check.method: Complete baseline path plotted and all parts, counts, bounds and hashes checked, followed by side-by-side visual comparison with complete official regional maps and inspected course descriptions. No georegistered overlay or exact line fit.
spatial_identity_check.regional_course_comparison: The selected northern inland route runs south through the Moora region, turns west along the Moore-labelled lower corridor, and reaches the Guilderton coast. This supports a representative Moore system identity across the complete selected path.
spatial_identity_check.named_transition_check: The inspected source explicitly distinguishes upstream named channels and North/East branches. Regional agreement does not establish which selected headwater parts carry each upstream name or their exact transition boundaries.
spatial_identity_check.bounded_unresolved_scope: The northern loop and upstream channel names remain unresolved at individual-part level. Neither basin labels nor monitoring-site names authorize applying Moore River to all 103 parts.
